title: DevHarness UI Intent Draft Output
description: Producer output contract for the DevHarness UI intent draft gate before architecture.

outcome.description: Producer must emit the single enum value that reflects the completed stage state; use blocked only when blocker explains the recoverable pause.
outcome.x-usage: Treat this as the authoritative workflow state for this output. Do not infer success from other populated fields when this says blocked.

summary.description: Producer must summarize the UI intent proposal state for human approval without embedding the ui-intent-contract artifact body.
summary.x-usage: Use this as the human-facing approval state for the UI intent gate. Show it with the artifact attachment; do not recreate the summary from artifact contents in the orchestrator.

artifacts.description: Producer must emit artifact metadata for the required immutable ui-intent-contract artifact when outcome is ready_for_attack.
artifacts.x-usage: Emit only the required immutable ui-intent-contract artifact. Exact artifact field semantics come from the shared baton artifact schema.

results.description: Producer may emit compact structured results, decisions, or evidence summaries created by this stage.
results.x-usage: Use these as supporting evidence or compact summaries. Do not let them override outcome, selected steps, blockers, or approved contracts.

summary.description: Producer must summarize the relevant decision or handoff in concise human-readable form without adding new scope.
summary.x-usage: Use this as concise human-readable context only. Do not route, approve, or expand scope from this text.

source_step_id.description: Producer must name the workflow step id that found or owns this blocker.
source_step_id.x-usage: Use this to identify the step that found or owns the blocker. Do not treat it as a retry target by itself.

needed.description: Producer must state the exact missing decision, permission, input, or evidence required to proceed.
needed.x-usage: Surface this exact missing input, permission, evidence, or decision before proceeding. When the blocker is user-answerable, treat this as the exact user-facing question to route to the user.

evidence.description: Producer should list concrete evidence references supporting this blocker.
evidence.x-usage: Use these references to inspect or challenge the claim. Do not assume unreferenced surfaces were checked.

risk.description: Producer should describe the residual risk if this blocker is ignored.
risk.x-usage: Use this to understand why ignoring the item is unsafe. Treat it as risk context unless paired with a blocked outcome.

blocker.description: Producer must populate this when outcome is blocked, naming the recoverable pause reason, owning step, and specific missing input or permission.
blocker.x-usage: Treat this as a recoverable pause. Surface the missing input or decision, route user-answerable questions to the user as questions, then continue this same workflow step after it is resolved.
